title: Deploy: free tiers, a domain, and something that stays up

videos.script: Deployed does not mean it ran once on a server. It means somebody can open it tomorrow, and next month, without you being there. {{tomorrow}} That takes more than starting a program. The program has to be packaged so the server can run it. Something has to restart it when it dies. It has to answer over HTTPS. And it has to be watched, so you find out it has stopped before a reviewer does. {{takes}} loanbook gets all of that here, for real, on the course's lab server. Including a crash it recovers from on its own. Then the internet: a domain, and a free tier chosen without trusting its price list.
